newProducts.name: Hair Regrowth Oil
newProducts.headline: Fall control & repair therapy
newProducts.keyIngredients: Virgin Coconut Oil, Lavender Oil, Rosemary Oil, Vitamin E
newProducts.description: Revitalise your hair with Puro's unique hair regrowth formula, a rejuvenating elixir designed to combat hair loss and stimulate regrowth. Experience the transformation as this potent formula works to give you fuller, thicker and softer hair — a promise of renewed confidence, and a journey to healthier, more resilient hair.
benefits: Stimulates the hair follicles and promotes hair growth
Improves the overall health of hair and scalp
newProducts.howToUse: Shake the bottle vigorously before each use. Take a few pumps, partition your hair and apply directly into the scalp, avoiding the lengths. For best results, leave on overnight and rinse off well with shampoo using normal to cold water.
newProducts.storage: Store in cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
